name: Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa
positioning: The Tommy Bahama brand's first resort, set on 11 acres of olive trees and citrus groves in Indian Wells with views of the Santa Rosa mountains
best_for: Golfers wanting a base moments from Indian Wells Golf Resort
Couples planning a spa-focused desert getaway

facts.text: Tommy Bahama Miramonte Resort & Spa is the first resort from the Tommy Bahama brand.
The resort sits on 11 acres of olive trees and citrus groves in Indian Wells, California.
The resort has sweeping views of the Santa Rosa mountains.
Rooms and suites are designed with woven textures, organic tones and Tommy Bahama's signature prints.
Spa Rosa is the resort's full-service spa, offering massages, facials and body treatments in a private courtyard setting.
The Hideaway Pool is tucked away within the resort and has sun decks and a heated whirlpool.
Private cabanas are available by reservation at the Chiki Palm Pool.
The resort is moments from Indian Wells Golf Resort and a short drive from PGA WEST.
The Indian Wells Tennis Garden, which hosts the annual BNP Paribas Open, is just minutes from the resort.
Live acoustic sets play in the Olive Grove every Thursday through Saturday evening.
The resort welcomes well-behaved dogs, with a maximum of two dogs per room.
The resort fee includes a daily two-hour bicycle rental for up to two guests.

highlights.text: With over 100 citrus trees on the grounds, guests can borrow a fruit picker and basket and pick their own fresh fruit.
There are four uniquely themed Villa Suites furnished with exclusive Tommy Bahama furniture.
Spa Rosa's River Bench has private waterfalls and nooks for privacy.
Spa Rosa's facilities include eucalyptus steam rooms, a hydrotherapy jacuzzi, a saltwater pool and an outdoor spa terrace.
At Grapefruit Basil, the olive grove patio has seating woven between mature olive trees.

considerations.text: Palm Springs International Airport is about 15 miles away, and the resort does not currently advertise a complimentary airport shuttle.
Guests must be at least 18 years old to use Spa Rosa.
The Miramonte King Room is on the second floor, reached by staircase, with no balcony or patio access.
